Wrapper function for the AMULET parameters

params_atac_amulet.Rd

Parameters of amulet_sc(), multiplet detection from fragment overlaps.

Usage

params_atac_amulet(
  max_overlap = 2L,
  max_fragment_len = 900L,
  repeat_q = 0.01,
  multiplet_q = 0.01,
  chroms = NULL,
  count_trailing_loci = FALSE
)

Arguments

max_overlap

Integer. Overlapping fragments a cell can explain; 2 for diploid. Defaults to 2L.

max_fragment_len

Integer. Longest valid fragment. Defaults to 900L.

repeat_q

Numeric. q-value under which a site is a repeat. Defaults to 0.01.

multiplet_q

Numeric. q-value under which a cell is a multiplet. Defaults to 0.01.

chroms

String vector or NULL. Chromosomes to use. NULL uses the autosomes. Defaults to NULL.

count_trailing_loci

Boolean. Count a cell's last loci on the last chromosome used, which the reference implementation drops. Defaults to FALSE.

Value

A named list with the following elements:

  • max_overlap - Integer. Overlapping fragments a cell can explain; 2 for diploid. Defaults to 2L.

  • max_fragment_len - Integer. Longest valid fragment. Defaults to 900L.

  • repeat_q - Numeric. q-value under which a site is a repeat. Defaults to 0.01.

  • multiplet_q - Numeric. q-value under which a cell is a multiplet. Defaults to 0.01.

  • chroms - String vector or NULL. Chromosomes to use. NULL uses the autosomes. Defaults to NULL.

  • count_trailing_loci - Boolean. Count a cell's last loci on the last chromosome used, which the reference implementation drops. Defaults to FALSE.

References

Thibodeau, et al., Genome Biol, 2021.
